Regulator response path.value: The Sustainability Risk Manager drafts survey and NCA responses, the Chief Risk Officer approves, and Regulatory Counsel clears any response that concedes a disclosure was incorrect or late before it is submitted

checklist.step: Maintain the register of sustainability disclosures and surveys
actions: Hold one register row per obligation: SFDR Art. 3 sustainability risk policy, Art. 4 principal adverse impacts statement, Art. 5 remuneration policy statement, Art. 6 pre-contractual, Arts. 8/9 product annexes, Art. 10 website product disclosure, Art. 11 periodic, Taxonomy Arts. 5-7 KPIs, plus each EIOPA or NCA survey.

Record for each row the legal citation, the RTS template reference from Delegated Regulation (EU) 2022/1288, the reporting period, the due date, the publication location and the named preparer, reviewer and approver.
Add the IDD-side obligations - sustainability factors in the POG target market under (EU) 2017/2358 and the suitability sustainability preferences under (EU) 2017/2359.
Re-confirm every row against the current EUR-Lex text at the start of each reporting cycle and record the confirmation date.
checklist.done: the register carries every disclosure and survey with citation, RTS template, due date, publication location and named owners, re-confirmed for the cycle.

checklist.step: Set the sustainability factors in the POG target market
actions: For each IBIP, state in the product approval documentation the sustainability factors the product delivers - Taxonomy-aligned investment proportion, SFDR sustainable-investment proportion, principal adverse impact consideration.
Define the target market to include, or expressly exclude, customers with sustainability preferences, per Delegated Regulation (EU) 2017/2358 as amended.
Publish the factors to distributors in the product information pack so they can match a customer's stated preference.
Re-review at the annual POG product review and whenever the underlying fund mandate changes.
checklist.done: each IBIP's approval documentation states its sustainability factors and target-market position, published to distributors and re-reviewed annually.

checklist.step: Operate the sustainability-preferences question set at point of sale
actions: Ask, after the standard suitability questions, whether the customer has sustainability preferences and, if so, in which of the three forms - Taxonomy-aligned proportion, SFDR sustainable investments, or consideration of principal adverse impacts.
Capture the answers as typed values, including the minimum proportion the customer requires, not as free text.
Match the recommendation to the stated preference and, where no product matches, record the explanation and the customer's decision to adapt the preference as the Delegated Regulation requires.
Never present the sustainability question before the general suitability assessment - the order is prescribed.
checklist.done: every advised IBIP sale records typed sustainability preferences, a matched product or a documented adaptation with the customer's decision.

checklist.step: Fix the data requirement list for each metric
actions: For each PAI indicator in Annex I of Delegated Regulation (EU) 2022/1288, list the required inputs - GHG emissions scopes 1, 2 and 3, carbon footprint, GHG intensity of investee companies, fossil fuel exposure, non-renewable energy share, board gender diversity, controversial weapons.
Name the source for each input: investee company reporting, the ESG data vendor feed, the investment book of record, or the underwriting exposure data.
State the required as-at date and the averaging basis - PAI indicators are computed as an average of four quarter-end observations.
Agree the delivery date for each input with the Chief Investment Officer's team and the data vendor, backed off from the 30 June publication.
checklist.done: each PAI indicator has a named source, as-at basis, averaging rule and an agreed delivery date from the data owner.

checklist.step: Collect and quality-check the input data
actions: Load the quarter-end investment holdings from the investment book of record and the ESG vendor file into the warehouse with the vendor file version and receipt date recorded.
Compute the coverage rate per indicator - holdings with reported data, holdings with vendor-estimated data and holdings with no data - by market value.
Run the quality rules: unit consistency on emissions, currency alignment on market values, duplicate issuer identifiers and outliers beyond agreed bounds.
Escalate any indicator below the agreed coverage floor to the Sustainability Risk Manager before calculation rather than proceeding on thin data.
checklist.done: input data is loaded with vendor versioning, coverage rates are computed per indicator and sub-floor coverage is escalated before calculation.

checklist.step: Calculate the metrics on the documented methodology
actions: Compute each PAI indicator using the RTS formula, weighting by current value of investment over the investee's enterprise value including cash where the RTS requires it.
Average the four quarter-end observations for the reference calendar year to produce the reported figure.
Compute the Taxonomy-alignment and SFDR sustainable-investment proportions per product on the same holdings basis so product and entity figures reconcile.
Record every assumption, estimation approach and exclusion in the calculation workbook next to the figure it affects.
checklist.done: every reported metric is computed on the RTS formula with the four-quarter average and its assumptions recorded beside it.

checklist.step: Draft the disclosures in the prescribed RTS templates
actions: Use the Delegated Regulation (EU) 2022/1288 annex templates unchanged - Annex I for the PAI statement, Annexes II and III for pre-contractual Art. 8 and Art. 9 products, Annexes IV and V for periodic disclosures.
Complete every mandatory field including the prior-period comparative, the actions taken and planned per indicator, and the narrative on data sources and limitations.
Do not add, reorder or rename template sections - the format is prescribed and a redesigned template is a breach in itself.
Cross-check each figure back to the calculation workbook cell reference and record the reference in the drafting notes.
checklist.done: each disclosure sits in the unmodified RTS template with every mandatory field completed and each figure tied to a workbook cell.

checklist.step: Reconcile the sustainability figures to the financial and investment reporting
actions: Reconcile the total market value underlying the PAI calculation to the investment book of record and to the financial statements at each quarter end.
Explain every difference - unlisted assets, derivatives, cash, look-through on collective investments - and record the explanation.
Reconcile per-product Taxonomy and sustainable-investment proportions to the sum of their underlying holdings.
Have the Statutory Reporting Manager confirm the financial figures used are the reported ones, not a management view.
checklist.done: sustainability figures reconcile to the investment book of record and reported financials, with every difference explained and confirmed.

checklist.step: Put the disclosures through independent review
actions: Re-perform a sample of indicator calculations from the raw holdings and vendor data without using the preparer's workbook.
Challenge the estimation approach where vendor-estimated data drives a material part of an indicator and require the limitation to be stated in the narrative.
Check the prior-period comparatives against last year's published statement and query any silent change.
Record the review, the challenges raised and their resolution in the model governance repository.
checklist.done: sampled indicators are independently re-performed, estimation limitations are stated and the review record is filed.

checklist.step: Obtain approval before publication
actions: Present the draft PAI statement, product annexes and website disclosures to the board risk committee with the coverage rates and the reviewer's challenges.
Confirm the statements are consistent with the firm's stated sustainability risk policy and its remuneration policy statement under SFDR Art. 5.
Approve in writing, naming the version approved and the intended publication date.
Record the committee minute reference against the disclosure register row.
checklist.done: each disclosure has a written approval naming the version and publication date, with a committee minute reference on the register.

checklist.step: Publish on time and capture the proof
actions: Publish the PAI statement in a separate, clearly identified website section by 30 June, and the product annexes with the pre-contractual pack and the annual report as SFDR Arts. 6 and 11 require.
Capture a timestamped PDF and a screenshot of the live page as published, and record the URL on the register row.
Confirm the customer portal and the broker portal surface the same current versions and that superseded versions are archived, not deleted.
Notify Distribution Compliance so distributors can point customers to the published information.
checklist.done: every disclosure is published by its statutory date with a timestamped capture, URL on the register and superseded versions archived.

checklist.step: Answer EIOPA and NCA sustainability surveys from the same source
actions: On receipt of a survey, log it on the register with the issuing body, the reference period, the submission deadline and the response channel.
Answer each question from the published disclosures and the underlying extracts so survey and public figures agree; where they must differ, state why in the response.
Have the Sustainability Risk Manager review and the Chief Risk Officer approve the response before submission.
Submit through the channel the request specifies and file the submitted file, the confirmation and the approval together.
checklist.done: each survey is logged, answered from published sources, approved and submitted with the confirmation filed.

checklist.step: Handle restatements openly
actions: Where a published figure is found wrong, quantify the error, its cause and whether it is material to a reader's decision.
Republish the corrected statement with a dated restatement note explaining what changed and why, rather than silently overwriting the file.
Assess with Regulatory Counsel whether the host NCA must be notified and record the decision.
Raise a root-cause action on the data or calculation step that produced the error.
checklist.done: every restatement is republished with a dated note, a notification assessment and a root-cause action.

checklist.step: Keep the sustainability question set and product data current
actions: Re-read Delegated Regulations (EU) 2017/2358 and 2017/2359 and the SFDR RTS at least annually for changes to the required preference categories or template content.
Update the point-of-sale question set and the product sustainability factors through the normal configuration change route with Compliance acceptance.
Retrain distribution staff on any change to the preference questioning and credit the hours to the IDD CPD total.
Record the review, whether or not a change resulted, so a no-change year is still evidenced.
checklist.done: an annual review of the sustainability rules is evidenced, with any change flowed through configuration, training and the register.

checklist.step: File the sustainability evidence set
actions: File the register extract, published PDFs and screenshots, calculation workbooks, vendor files, coverage analyses, review records, approvals and survey submissions under the reporting year.
Apply the 10-year retention label and lock the published versions against edit.
Confirm the set is searchable by disclosure type, product, indicator and publication date.
Hand the set to the Model Risk Manager as the independent reviewer for the annual test.
checklist.done: a locked, retention-labelled and searchable sustainability evidence set is filed and handed to the independent reviewer.

testing.step: Build the population of required disclosures and surveys
actions: Extract the disclosure register for the reporting year with due dates, publication dates, URLs and owners.
Independently derive the required list from SFDR Arts. 3-11, the RTS annexes and the Taxonomy Regulation for the entity and every Art. 8 and Art. 9 product sold, and compare it to the register.
Add every survey received in the year from the regulatory correspondence log so an unlogged survey cannot hide.
Resolve every difference between the derived list and the register before sampling.
testing.done: the register is reconciled to an independently derived requirement list and the correspondence log, with all differences resolved.

testing.step: Verify publication dates against the statutory deadlines
actions: Compare each publication timestamp to its statutory date - 30 June for the Art. 4 PAI statement, annual report date for Art. 11 periodic disclosures.
Verify the timestamp from the website capture and the content management publication log, not from the register field.
Check the correct reference period is stated on each statement and that the prior-period comparative is present where required.
List every late publication with the days late and the reason recorded.
testing.done: every publication date is independently verified against source evidence and its statutory deadline, with late items listed.

testing.step: Draw a documented sample of metrics and disclosures
actions: Take 100% of the mandatory PAI indicators in Annex I Table 1, 100% of Art. 9 products and 100% of survey responses.
Take 10 further metrics by seeded random selection across the optional indicators and the Art. 8 product annexes.
Record the seed, the population size, the strata and the selection date in the workpaper so the sample can be re-drawn.
testing.done: the sample is reproducible, covers all mandatory PAI indicators, Art. 9 products and surveys, and its method is documented.

testing.step: Recompute sampled metrics from raw holdings and vendor data
actions: Pull the four quarter-end holdings extracts and the vendor ESG file versions used and rebuild the indicator calculation from the RTS formula without the preparer's workbook.
Compare the recomputed value to the published figure and record any difference above the agreed materiality as an exception.
Re-derive the coverage rate and check the published narrative states the actual data-availability limitation rather than a generic caveat.
Check the weighting basis - current value of investment over enterprise value including cash - was applied as the RTS prescribes.
testing.done: each sampled metric is independently recomputed from raw data and reconciles to the published figure within materiality.

testing.step: Test template compliance against the RTS annexes
actions: Open the Delegated Regulation (EU) 2022/1288 annex templates and compare each published statement section by section.
Fail any renamed, reordered, merged or omitted section and any mandatory field left blank or answered 'not applicable' without justification.
Check the actions-taken and actions-planned narrative is present per indicator and is specific rather than boilerplate.
Check the prior-period comparative matches last year's published statement and query any unannounced change.
testing.done: each published statement is verified section by section against the unmodified RTS template with all mandatory fields complete.

testing.step: Reconcile sustainability figures to the investment and financial records
actions: Reconcile the total market value underlying the calculation to the investment book of record at each quarter end.
Reconcile the same total to the reported financial statements and check every explained difference is genuinely explained, not labelled.
Reconcile per-product Taxonomy and sustainable-investment proportions to the sum of their underlying holdings.
Record the reconciliation in the workpaper with the differences and their causes.
testing.done: underlying values reconcile to the investment book of record and reported financials with every difference substantiated.

testing.step: Test the point-of-sale sustainability-preference capture
actions: Extract all advised IBIP sales in the year and compute the proportion with typed sustainability-preference answers captured.
Sample 25 sales and check the preference question followed the general suitability assessment in the recorded sequence.
Where a preference was stated, check the recommended product's sustainability factors match it, or that an adaptation is documented with the customer's decision.
Fail any sale where a preference was recorded and an unmatched product was sold with no documented adaptation.
testing.done: preference capture is measured across all advised IBIP sales and matching or documented adaptation is verified on the sample.

testing.step: Test survey responses against their source
actions: For each survey response trace every quantitative answer to the published disclosure or the underlying extract it came from.
List any answer that differs from the published figure without a stated explanation in the response.
Confirm the Chief Risk Officer approval pre-dates submission and that the submission confirmation is filed.
Compare the submission date to the deadline stated in the request and list any late return.
testing.done: every survey answer traces to a published or extracted source, with pre-dated approval and an on-time filed confirmation.

testing.step: Log exceptions with root cause, owner and restatement decision
actions: Raise an issue per exception with the disclosure, the indicator, the published versus recomputed figure and the reader materiality.
Assign a root cause (vendor data version drift, coverage below floor, formula misapplied, template altered, preference capture not enforced) and a named owner.
Set a remediation date and, where a published figure is wrong, require a restatement and notification assessment with Regulatory Counsel before closure.
Carry every open issue into the next year's test as a mandatory retest row.
testing.done: every exception has an issue with root cause, owner, restatement decision where needed and a retest commitment.

testing.step: Conclude, sign and report the test
actions: State the number of disclosures published on time, the recomputation agreement rate and the sustainability-preference capture rate against their thresholds.
Write the conclusion - effective, effective with exceptions, or ineffective - citing the recomputation workpapers and any restatement.
Have the independent reviewer, who prepared or approved none of the tested metrics, sign the workpaper.
Report to the board risk committee and file the workpaper in the compliance evidence repository.
testing.done: a signed workpaper with a stated conclusion, timeliness and recomputation rates and a board committee reporting date is filed.

Accountable obligation owner.value: Owns the continuously maintained workpaper estate behind the IDD and sustainability disclosures - source-to-report lineage, methodology documents, vendor data provenance, coverage and estimation records and the restatement trail - so any published or disclosed figure can be reproduced years later

Citation verified against current regula.value: Yes - the retention and reproducibility requirement is driven by IDD (EU) 2016/97 Art. 10(8) and Art. 30(5) record-keeping expectations read with Delegated Regulation (EU) 2017/2359 Arts. 14 and 19 (records of suitability and demands-and-needs assessments) and SFDR (EU) 2019/2088 Art. 4 with the RTS in Delegated Regulation (EU) 2022/1288 requiring stated data sources, methodologies and limitations

In-scope processes.value: Data sourcing from the investment book of record, policy administration, the ESG vendor feed and the suitability capture; transformation and calculation; methodology authoring and change control; workpaper assembly, review and retention for every IDD and sustainability disclosure

In-scope systems.value: Data catalogue holding lineage, ownership and quality rules over the warehouse tables feeding the disclosures, with methodology documents and signed workpapers held in the model governance repository

Compliance procedure documented.value: Disclosure Workpaper and Methodology Standard - required workpaper contents (source extract with query and timestamp, transformation log, calculation file, methodology reference, coverage analysis, reviewer sign-off), the naming and versioning convention, and the reproduction test every workpaper must pass

Compliance procedure approved.value: Approved by the Chief Data Officer and the Chief Risk Officer; reviewed annually and on any change to a disclosure methodology or a source system

Filing/reporting deadlines tracked.value: Continuous - the workpaper must be complete and reviewer-signed before the disclosure it supports is published, quarterly lineage and quality attestations close within 10 business days of quarter end, and the annual methodology review closes before the 30 June PAI cycle begins

Deadline reminders configured.value: Catalogue tasks at quarter end plus 5 days for lineage attestation, a workpaper-completeness gate task blocking each disclosure approval, and automated alerts when a source table's schema or a vendor file version changes

Evidence retained per the retention requ.value: Source extracts, transformation logs, calculation files, methodology versions, vendor licences and files, coverage analyses and reviewer sign-offs retained 10 years in immutable storage aligned to the disclosure they support

Violations/exceptions logged with dispos.value: Any disclosure figure that cannot be reproduced from its workpaper, any undocumented methodology change and any expired vendor licence over data still in use is logged with owner, impact on published figures and remediation date

Remediation sign-off captured.value: Signs off every methodology change, every workpaper gap remediation and any decision to publish where a data limitation could not be closed

Test population (in-scope transactions,.value: Every workpaper supporting an IDD or sustainability disclosure published or submitted in the period, plus the catalogued lineage for each source table feeding those disclosures

Pass/fail thresholds.value: 100% of sampled figures must be reproducible from the archived workpaper by an independent preparer within tolerance; any methodology change applied without an approved version, or any source extract without a saved query and timestamp, is a fail

Compliance test frequency matched to the.value: Obligation is continuous; lineage and quality attestations are tested quarterly and full reproduction testing runs annually across the disclosure population, plus on demand ahead of any regulator request

Independent reviewer (segregated from th.value: Reviewer must not have authored the methodology, prepared the extract or performed the calculation being reproduced

Evidence location for test results.value: Workpaper reproducibility test file (sampled workpapers, reproduction attempts and outcomes, lineage checks, vendor licence checks, exceptions) in the compliance evidence repository, cross-linked from the model governance repository

Regulator-ready documentation.value: For any named published figure: the archived source extract with its query and timestamp, the transformation log, the calculation file, the methodology version and the reviewer sign-off, assembled and producible within 5 business days

Regulator response path.value: The Data Governance Lead assembles the workpaper pack, the Sustainability Risk Manager or the relevant obligation owner presents it through Compliance, and Regulatory Counsel clears any statement that a figure cannot be reproduced

checklist.step: Map every disclosed figure to its source data element
actions: Take the disclosure register and list every quantitative figure published or submitted - PAI indicators, Taxonomy proportions, IBIP aggregate costs, complaint volumes, competence hours, notice timeliness rates.
Trace each figure to the warehouse table and column that produces it and register the lineage in the catalogue.
Name a data owner and a data steward for each source element and record them on the catalogue entry.
Flag any figure with no catalogued lineage as an immediate gap and assign an owner to close it before the next publication.
checklist.done: every disclosed figure has catalogued lineage to a named source element with an owner and steward, and gaps are assigned.

checklist.step: Author and version the methodology for each figure
actions: Write one methodology document per figure stating the formula, the population, inclusions and exclusions, the as-at and averaging basis, the estimation approach for missing data and the known limitations.
Cite the regulatory source of the formula - the RTS annex, the Directive article or the internal policy - inside the document.
Version the document with an effective date and require the version to be named on every workpaper that applies it.
Route material changes through the Chief Data Officer for approval before they are used in a published figure.
checklist.done: each figure has a versioned, cited methodology document whose effective date governs the workpapers applying it.

checklist.step: Control the source extracts so they can be re-run
actions: Run every disclosure extract from a saved, version-controlled query rather than an ad hoc session.
Record with each extract the query version, the parameters, the run timestamp, the row count and a checksum of the output.
Pin the extract to a time-travel snapshot or an immutable copy so a later data correction does not silently change history.
Store the extract file with its metadata alongside the workpaper it supports.
checklist.done: every extract is produced from a versioned query and stored with parameters, timestamp, row count, checksum and a pinned snapshot.

checklist.step: Record vendor data provenance and licence terms
actions: For each ESG or market data vendor record the file name, version, delivery date, coverage universe and the methodology the vendor applies to estimated values.
Hold the licence terms and confirm the right to use the data in public regulatory disclosures and to retain it for the 10-year period.
Track licence expiry and renegotiate before expiry rather than continuing to use data the firm no longer has the right to publish.
Store the vendor file itself, not just a reference, so the figure can be reproduced if the vendor withdraws access.
checklist.done: each vendor dataset has a recorded version, coverage, estimation methodology, in-force publication licence and a retained copy of the file.

checklist.step: Log every transformation between source and figure
actions: Capture the pipeline run id, code version, input and output row counts and any records rejected by a quality rule for each disclosure run.
Write manual adjustments as coded, reviewed steps rather than as spreadsheet edits after extraction.
Where a manual override is unavoidable, log the value before and after, the reason, the approver and the date on the transformation log.
Store the transformation log with the workpaper so the path from source rows to reported figure is continuous.
checklist.done: the transformation log gives a continuous, reviewed path from source rows to the reported figure, with every override justified and approved.

checklist.step: Quantify coverage, estimation and quality for each figure
actions: Compute per figure the share of the population with reported data, with vendor-estimated data and with no data, weighted as the metric is weighted.
Run the catalogue's quality rules - completeness, validity, uniqueness, timeliness - and record the pass rate and the failing record counts.
Compare coverage and quality to the agreed floors and escalate any breach to the Data Governance Lead before the figure is used.
Write the coverage and quality statement into the workpaper so the disclosure narrative can state the limitation accurately.
checklist.done: each figure carries a weighted coverage split, quality rule results against agreed floors and a written limitation statement.

checklist.step: Assemble the workpaper to the standard
actions: Build one workpaper per figure containing the source extract and its metadata, the transformation log, the calculation file, the methodology version reference, the coverage and quality statement and the reconciliation to the source of record.
Name it to the convention - <disclosure>-<figure>-<reference period>-v<n> - so it can be found from the published statement.
Cross-reference the published figure's location - statement, section, line - inside the workpaper.
Refuse to submit an incomplete workpaper for review; a missing extract query is not a documentation gap, it is an unreproducible figure.
checklist.done: each figure has a complete, conventionally named workpaper cross-referenced to where the figure was published.

checklist.step: Have an independent preparer reproduce the figure
actions: Give the workpaper to a preparer who did not build it and ask them to reproduce the figure from the extract and the methodology alone.
Record the reproduced value, the time taken and every question they had to ask - a question is a gap in the workpaper.
Where the value cannot be reproduced within tolerance, return the workpaper for completion before the disclosure is approved.
File the reproduction note with the workpaper as the evidence that the standard was met.
checklist.done: each workpaper carries a reproduction note from an independent preparer showing the figure was rebuilt within tolerance.

checklist.step: Gate the disclosure approval on workpaper completeness
actions: Add a mandatory workpaper-complete task to each disclosure approval workflow, referencing the workpaper id and the reproduction note.
Block approval where any figure in the disclosure has no completed workpaper.
Record the workpaper ids on the disclosure register row so a regulator request can be served from the register.
Report blocked approvals to the Chief Data Officer weekly during a reporting cycle.
checklist.done: no disclosure can be approved without every figure's workpaper id and reproduction note recorded on the register.

checklist.step: Attest lineage, ownership and quality each quarter
actions: Within 10 business days of quarter end, confirm for each catalogued source element that the lineage is still accurate, the owner is still in post and the quality rules still run.
Re-check that no upstream schema change has broken a mapping since the last attestation.
Record the attestation with name and date; an unattested element is treated as unowned and escalated.
Raise a catalogue change request for every difference found rather than editing the entry silently.
checklist.done: every source element carries a dated quarterly attestation on lineage, ownership and quality, with differences raised as change requests.

checklist.step: Control methodology and source changes
actions: Require any change to a disclosure methodology, a source system field or a vendor feed to be raised as a change with the affected figures listed.
Assess and record whether the change makes prior-period figures non-comparable and whether a restatement or a comparability note is needed.
Obtain Chief Data Officer approval before the change is used in a published figure.
Update the methodology version and the catalogue entry as part of the change, not afterwards.
checklist.done: every methodology or source change carries a listed impact on figures, a comparability assessment, approval and same-change catalogue updates.

checklist.step: Retain the workpapers immutably for ten years
actions: Move each approved workpaper set into immutable storage on publication of the disclosure it supports.
Apply the 10-year retention label aligned to the disclosure's reference period and set legal-hold capability for regulator requests.
Verify the stored copy by checksum against the approved version rather than assuming the transfer succeeded.
Run an annual restore test on a sample of five workpapers to prove they can still be opened and read.
checklist.done: workpapers are stored immutably with verified checksums, 10-year retention and an annual restore test on a sample.

checklist.step: Keep a serve-on-demand pack ready for regulators
actions: Maintain an index that turns any published figure into its workpaper id, methodology version and evidence location in a single lookup.
Rehearse the assembly once a year by picking two published figures at random and building the pack against the 5-business-day standard.
Record the rehearsal time and any obstacle found, and fix the obstacle rather than noting it.
Brief the Sustainability Risk Manager and Regulatory Reporting Manager on how to request an assembly out of hours.
checklist.done: a figure-to-workpaper index exists and an annual rehearsal proves a pack can be assembled inside 5 business days.

checklist.step: Report data-support health to governance
actions: Report quarterly to the data governance forum: catalogued lineage coverage, attestation completion, coverage rates by indicator, open workpaper gaps and reproduction failures.
Escalate to the board risk committee any published figure that cannot currently be reproduced.
Record decisions on data investment where a coverage floor cannot be met from current sources.
Track every open gap to closure with a named owner and a date.
checklist.done: the forum minute records lineage coverage, attestation completion, reproduction failures and owned, dated actions.

checklist.step: File the quarterly data-support evidence pack
actions: Assemble the quarter's attestations, quality rule results, coverage analyses, change records and reproduction notes.
File under the quarter with the 10-year retention label and link it from the disclosure register rows it supports.
Confirm the pack is searchable by figure, source element, methodology version and reference period.
Hand it to the Model Risk Manager as the independent reviewer for the annual reproducibility test.
checklist.done: a searchable, retention-labelled quarterly data-support pack is filed, linked to the register and handed to the independent reviewer.

testing.step: Build the population of workpapers and source elements
actions: Extract every disclosure published or submitted in the period from the register with its listed workpaper ids.
Extract from the catalogue every source element feeding those disclosures with its owner, steward and last attestation date.
List every published figure with no workpaper id and every workpaper with no published figure, and resolve both before sampling.
Reconcile the count of figures to the count of workpapers and sign the population as complete.
testing.done: the population reconciles published figures to workpapers and catalogued source elements, signed as complete by the extractor.

testing.step: Reconcile catalogued lineage to the actual pipeline
actions: Take the catalogue lineage for five disclosure figures and compare it to the pipeline definitions and the warehouse view SQL that actually produce them.
List every table or transformation present in the pipeline but absent from the catalogue.
Check no upstream schema change since the last attestation has broken a mapping.
Treat catalogue lineage that does not match the running pipeline as a control failure, not a documentation lag.
testing.done: catalogued lineage is verified against running pipeline definitions for five figures, with every difference listed as a failure.

testing.step: Draw a documented sample of figures to reproduce
actions: Take 100% of figures published externally under SFDR Art. 4 and 100% of figures used in a regulator survey response.
Take 10 further figures by seeded random selection across IDD operational metrics - notice timeliness, complaint volumes, competence hours.
Record the seed, the population size, the strata and the selection date so the sample can be re-drawn.
testing.done: the sample is reproducible, covers all externally published and survey figures, and its method is documented.

testing.step: Re-perform the reproduction test from the archived workpaper alone
actions: Take each sampled workpaper and rebuild the figure using only the archived extract, the transformation log and the named methodology version.
Do not contact the original preparer; every question that cannot be answered from the workpaper is recorded as a gap.
Compare the reproduced value to the published figure and record any difference above the stated tolerance as an exception.
Record the elapsed time and compare it to the 5-business-day regulator-service standard.
testing.done: each sampled figure is rebuilt from the archived workpaper alone, with differences, gaps and elapsed time recorded.

testing.step: Re-run the source extract and compare to the archived copy
actions: Re-run each sampled saved query against the pinned snapshot with the recorded parameters.
Compare row count and checksum to the archived extract metadata and list every difference.
Where the snapshot no longer exists, record it as a reproducibility failure regardless of whether the figure still calculates.
Check no correction applied to the source after publication silently changed the historic figure.
testing.done: every sampled extract re-runs to the same row count and checksum against a surviving pinned snapshot, or is logged as a failure.

testing.step: Test methodology versioning and change control
actions: For each sampled figure confirm the workpaper names a methodology version whose effective date covers the reference period.
Compare the formula actually applied in the calculation file to the formula in that methodology version and list any difference.
For every methodology change in the period confirm a change record, an impact-on-figures list, a comparability assessment and Chief Data Officer approval exist.
List any methodology change applied to a published figure without an approved version.
testing.done: applied formulas match the effective methodology version and every change is approved with a comparability assessment.

testing.step: Test vendor data provenance and licence rights
actions: For each vendor dataset used in a sampled figure confirm the retained file version matches the version named in the workpaper.
Check the licence in force at publication permitted public regulatory disclosure and 10-year retention.
Check the vendor's own estimation methodology for the dataset is documented and that estimated values are identified as such in the workpaper.
List any figure relying on data the firm no longer has the right to hold or publish.
testing.done: vendor file versions, publication and retention rights and estimation identification are verified for every sampled figure.

testing.step: Test attestation completeness and retention integrity
actions: Check every catalogued source element in the population has a quarterly attestation within 10 business days of each quarter end.
List unattested elements and check whether an owner was in post throughout the period.
Restore five archived workpapers from immutable storage, open them and verify the checksum against the approved version.
Confirm the retention label is 10 years from the correct reference period and that legal hold can be applied.
testing.done: attestations are complete and timely and five workpapers restore, open and checksum-match with correct retention labels.

testing.step: Log exceptions with root cause, owner and impact on published figures
actions: Raise an issue per exception naming the figure, the disclosure it was published in, the reproduction result and the reader materiality.
Assign a root cause (snapshot not pinned, manual spreadsheet adjustment, methodology version drift, expired vendor licence, unattested element) and a named owner.
Set a remediation date and, where a published figure could not be reproduced, require a restatement assessment with the Chief Risk Officer and Regulatory Counsel before closure.
Carry every open issue into the next annual test as a mandatory retest row.
testing.done: every exception has an issue with root cause, owner, published-figure impact, restatement assessment where needed and a retest commitment.

testing.step: Conclude, sign and report the test
actions: State the reproduction success rate against the 100% threshold, the number of unpinned extracts and the attestation completion rate.
Write the conclusion - effective, effective with exceptions, or ineffective - on whether every disclosed figure can be evidenced to a regulator.
Have the independent reviewer, who authored none of the tested methodologies or calculations, sign the workpaper.
Report to the data governance forum and the board risk committee and file the workpaper in the compliance evidence repository.
testing.done: a signed workpaper with a stated conclusion, reproduction success rate and dual governance reporting is filed in the repository.
